column1: # A bucket of the event journal (the event journal contract, bucket torn and line): the content of the file (a JSON string) → the ids of the rows read in order, the counts torn and garbled. The form — README.

column4: note
two full lines
an empty bucket
the last fragment without LF parses as JSON — still not a line: torn (the writer may be appending)
the last fragment without LF is cut off
a full line not JSON — skipped, the bucket goes on
a full line without kind — out of form line
t as a string — the reader is tolerant: the time common.time reads as a number or a string (the codec; EJ-G07)
t with milliseconds, occurred as a string — reads
more than three fraction digits — the reader is tolerant (the writer does not write so)
a notation with an exponent — not a time for the reader: the line is out of form
a negative t — not a time
occurred not a time — the line is out of form
v and a field beyond the form — the reader tolerates them and keeps them as is (the writer does not write v; EJ-G10)
a repeat of an id in a bucket — the first line wins, the count duplicate (EJ-L06)
a full JSON tail without LF after an appended LF — an ordinary line with its own id (EJ-L06)
the journal is «at least once»: an event before a failure without LF and its repeat — one line, the count duplicate (EJ-L06)
a full line — a JSON array, not an object
a wrong full line and a torn tail in one bucket — both counts
the depth of the whole line — JSON_DEPTH 128 P/01.1 Н2.1 (objects and arrays, the root object — 1): 128 reads, 129 — unreadable, garbled (EJ-DEPTH-BASELINE33)
a time value is finite in binary64: 1e308 (309 digits) reads, 2e308 — an overflow, out of form, garbled (the canon P/01.1 Н0, codec time; MAY-UNTIL-D8-01)
